title: Probe + fix inconsistent 'started' timestamp on shards (retry vs first-attempt)
description:
Shards processed via the orchestrator workflow inconsistently get a 'started' timestamp: present after retry path, sometimes absent on first-attempt success.

Observed during TASK-020 acceptance test against issues-plugin: TASK-001 (which needed attempt-2) had 'started' set; TASK-002 (first-attempt success) did not. Both had 'completed'. Investigation needed in scripts/branch-setup.mjs status-flip logic (the buildBacklogToInProgress path) and any retry replay code.

Expected behavior: 'started' should be set exactly once, on the first transition from backlog to in-progress, regardless of attempt count.
acceptance_criteria: Probe: trace 'started' field assignment in scripts/branch-setup.mjs and any merge-task.mjs status writes; document which code path sets it.
Fix: ensure 'started' is set on FIRST status flip from backlog to in-progress, never reset on retry.
Add unit test: shard goes through (backlog -> in-progress -> backlog -> in-progress -> done) cycle, 'started' is the FIRST in-progress timestamp not the last.
Add unit test: shard goes through (backlog -> in-progress -> done) on first attempt, 'started' is set.
